notes: Base model has two 4-outlet banks (Non-Critical Load / Critical Load), each bank ganged behind one resettable circuit breaker — modeled here as two representative NEMA 5-15R outlet ports per bank (8 total), matching the "Rear Panel Description – Bank Outlets" diagram in the official manual (I-00319 Rev J). A separate SKU variant (UPS-1000R-8) has individually-controlled/individually-breakered outlets instead of banks; connector set is otherwise identical. The RJ11/RJ45 ports and Coax/Cable/DSS (F-type) ports are surge-protection pass-throughs (one IN + one OUT each) for phone/DSL/Ethernet and cable/CATV/DSS lines, not UPS data ports, so no bandwidth grade applies and they are not networking uplinks. USB port type is not explicitly stated in any source; modeled as USB-B (standard for UPS-to-PC management ports of this class) — this is inferred, not confirmed, hence flagged. Two DB-9 serial ports: "Serial Port Primary" (true RS232 to PC/control system) and "Serial Port Secondary I/O" (analog status I/O on a DB-9, not full RS232) — modeled as rs232 for primary and rs232 (closest available id) for secondary since a generic DB-9 analog-I/O id isn't in the allowed connector list. EPO port is a small barrel-style contact-closure connector — no exact id in the allowed list; modeled as dc-barrel (closest physical match) per instructions. External Battery Pack Connector (proprietary, for UPS-EBPR chaining) also has no matching id; modeled as dc-barrel as the closest analog. Expansion port slot for optional NIC (UPS-IPCARD, used on the -IP variant) is a card slot, not a cable port, so it was omitted. Ground stud omitted (not a signal/power connector). Rack size is 2U per manufacturer spec table.
